clean_repro.observed: Request with empty metricType returned HTTP 200 success; describe shows actual metricType=COSINE (default), empty string was silently accepted and defaulted

contract_refs: constraint_id: milvus_type_collections_create_002, assertion: 'metricType in [L2, IP, COSINE]', type: type_constraint

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: HTTP request → handler_v2.go parseRequestBody → metricType empty check → default to COSINE → CreateIndex
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现: REST v2 handler仅检查metricType是否为空(len=0)，若为空则默认为COSINE。完全没有验证metricType是否属于枚举值[L2, IP, COSINE]。empty string通过len检查被接受并默认，但如果是其他非法值(如'INVALID')也会同样被接受而不报错。

falsification.probe: Describe created collection to verify actual metricType value
falsification.observed: Collection created with metricType="" shows indexes[0].metricType=COSINE in describe response, confirming empty string was defaulted rather than rejected per contract

cognition_match.developer_quote: REST v2 API data type serialization - 8 issues in corpus; REST v2 and gRPC divergent validation: REST v2 accepting values the gRPC path rejects
cognition_match.note: 命中盲点指标: REST v2参数验证缺失。metricType枚举值约束未被 enforced，非法值被接受。

verdicts.rationale: REST v2 API接受空字符串metricType并默认为COSINE，契约明文要求metricType in [L2, IP, COSINE] (milvus_type_collections_create_002)，但源码handler_v2.go:2067仅检查len==0后默认，无枚举值验证。这是真缺陷：参数验证缺失允许非法值通过。
